method: Unchanged native empty cart tick/interact, rider positioning, server player mountEntity(null)/dismountEntity, ItemMinecart.onItemUse and break drops. Map-backed World with original block collision boxes, fixed rider moveForward/yaw, player yOffset=0 (feet). Cart onUpdate then rider updateRiderPosition per tick. Rider fall hook records forwarded distance; full player onUpdate/damage is not executed. Native interaction returns true for another player in an occupied cart but leaves that player unmounted. Sneaking refusal is the browser input contract, not EntityMinecartEmpty.interactFirst bytecode. Item stack count here is ItemMinecart alone; Creative preservation belongs to PlayerController. Drop constructor motion uses Math.random and is excluded from replay. No patched game classes.
